column7: On the left of the frame, a man in a fedora and a long trench coat stands with his back to the camera, only the back of his hat and shoulders visible, no face. He faces a scarred wooden table with three open folders spread in a fan, blank pages, and an empty wooden chair on the far side. Venetian blinds behind, one low hanging lamp above the table casting a hard pool of amber light, a thin curl of smoke in the air. Drawn illustration: clean black contour outlines around every shape, flat colour areas, shading only in a few hard cel steps. Palette of charcoal, dark brown and amber.
